title: Carousel Content Object
description: LLM output before any Templated template is involved. Template-agnostic — knows only slide_type, never template_id. Defined in DC-003-T002 §2. Per-slide-type content shape (e.g. that a 'cover' slide's content needs eyebrow_text/headline_text/body_text) is documented in T002 §2 and config/templates.json's 'variable' layer lists, not enforced here as a conditional schema — kept simple deliberately for the foundation phase.

content.description: Shape depends on slide_type — see DC-003-T002 §2 for the field list per type.
